question: When light passes from water to air then _______ changes.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both 1 and 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When light passes from water (a denser medium) to air (a rarer medium), its wavelength and speed change. Its frequency, however, remains constant. 
 
• Speed = Frequency times Wavelength
 
• Refraction occurs because light travels at different speeds in different mediums.
 
• 
 
Refraction: 

 
 
• When a ray of light passes from one medium to another it suffers a change in direction at the boundary of two media is called refraction.
 
• The change in direction because the speed of light travels at different speeds in different mediums. The Refractive Index of a medium defines that it is denser or rarer
 
• 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82339a0de627554b07235929cdd32b43851718b65b7114397e275f2df207692c.png] 

 
 
• Snell’s law of refraction: “The ratio of the sine of the angle of incidence to the sine of the angle of refraction is a constant, for the light of a given colour and for the given pair of media”. ​
 
• frac{{Sin i}}{{Sin r}} = frac{{{n₂}}}{{{n₁}}}=constant
 
Where n2 and n1 are the refractive indexes of the two mediums 2 and 1 respectively.

 
Explanation:__

 
From the above explanation, we can see that, 

 
 
• The bending of light when it enters from one medium to another is known as the Refraction of Light.
 
• The bouncing back of a light ray when it strikes a smooth polished surface is known as the Reflection of Light. Also according to the law of Reflection angle of the angle of incidence is equal to the angle of refraction. 
 
• The coin appears to be raised because the light reaching us from the portion of the pencil inside the water seems to come from a different direction, as compared to the part above the water.
 
• This happens because the speed of light is different in a different medium, and thus the direction of light changes when it enters from one medium to another.
